a.lede: The iPhone Duo has its frustrations, but it’s also fun and engaging enough that I didn’t want to switch back to my Pro Max.
a.title: I took two iPhones on vacation. The Duo won me over.

b.lede: Apple’s foldable iPhone Duo was a hit with people willing to spend $2,000 on a new mobile.
b.title: Apple unsure when more foldable iPhones will be available after selling out
